positions.title: IT Consultant/Technician
positions.description:
Act as on-site and remote support for customer network and software
Troubleshoot and provide technical assistance
Draft proposals and statements of work for solutions
Respond to customer requests for product or solution information
Generate sales through securing new customers and servicing the current client base
Schedule and conduct routine maintenance service calls
Documentation of sales calls, service calls, etc.
